nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=85 beats='{HERO} the {HERO_KIND} is playing on the {PLAY_PLACE} and notices one {ITEM_COLOR} {LOST_ITEM} is gone; one bare hand is cold; {HERO} decides to look for it'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=80 beats='No {LOST_ITEM} under the {LANDMARK_A}, but {HERO} spots little footprints in the snow heading toward the {MEETING_PLACE}; a gentle clue, never scary'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=80 beats='{FRIEND} the {FRIEND_KIND} has not seen the {LOST_ITEM} but says she heard {HELPERS} chirping by the {MEETING_PLACE} about something {ITEM_COLOR}'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=80 beats='The {LOST_ITEM} is not on the {LANDMARK_B}, but a single {ITEM_COLOR} thread is caught on a twig pointing toward the {MEETING_PLACE}'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=85 beats='At the frozen {MEETING_PLACE} {HERO} sees a flash of {ITEM_COLOR} in the snow, hears {HELPERS} chirping above, and smells warm {HOME_TREAT} from home; three friendly paths'>>

choices.label: Reach for the {ITEM_COLOR} thing in the snow.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=80 beats='The {HELPERS} show {HERO} the {ITEM_COLOR} {LOST_ITEM} snagged on a low branch, just out of reach; {HERO} can stretch up or call for help'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=80 beats='{HERO}s friends {FRIEND} and the {FRIEND_GROUP} make a wobbly, giggly chain to reach the high branch together'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=80 beats='At home {CAREGIVER} has warm {HOME_TREAT}; as {HERO} pulls off the snowy {OUTER_GEAR}, something {ITEM_COLOR} tumbles out of a {OUTER_GEAR_ONE}'>>

choices.label: See what fell out of the {OUTER_GEAR_ONE}.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=completion words=80 beats='{HERO} picks up the {ITEM_COLOR} {LOST_ITEM} and slips it on; both hands are warm again; a happy, cozy resolution'>>
<<FILL role=completion words=80 beats='The friends lift the {LOST_ITEM} down all together and cheer; {HERO} is warm and grateful for good friends'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='The lost {LOST_ITEM} was tucked inside {HERO}s {OUTER_GEAR_ONE} the whole time; everyone laughs and shares {HOME_TREAT}; a gentle, funny ending'>>
